descriptionByLocale.it:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position As a Digital Campaign Delivery Intern in the Global Digital Hub, you support the successful delivery of digital campaigns content creation projects within the Digital Campaigns Chapter. The role plays a role in ensuring timely and high-quality digital campaigns content creation coordination and completion. The Digital Campaign Delivery Intern will collaborate closely with the Campaign Delivery Specialists to support affiliate business teams or brand teams, third-party-vendors, campaign and global campaign coordinators in the organization, related to project requirements, objectives, and timelines. Responsibilities
• Manage the affiliate or global digital campaigns content creation and delivery process, ensuring timely and successful completion of any projects from initiation to final implementation, while ensuring delivery standards are met.
• Incorporate feedback from stakeholders and revise digital campaigns content requests accordingly to ensure alignment with their expectations.
• Incorporates feedback on new process or requirements that would increase efficiency in the ways of working in subject matter area
• Adoption and Center of Excellence: follow existing processes, establish process governance principles and maintain proper documentation and implementation within the scope of responsibility Who you are You are a person with high interest and ability in project coordination with understanding of digital marketing principles and content creation processes. Your excellent organizational and communication skills enable you to manage multiple projects efficiently, ensuring timely and high-quality delivery. You excel at collaborating with diverse teams and adapting to their feedback to meet their needs and expectations. Further requirements
• Proficient in English and German language
• You have ongoing studies at any Hungarian University/college
• You are available at least 20-25 hours per week
• You are passionate about project management
• You're organized, detail-oriented, self-motivated, with the ability to easily transition between multiple tasks and problem solve thoughtfully
• You have highly developed interpersonal and communication skills
• You are a quick learner, proactive, flexible and curious with an an innovative mind
• You are a strong team player with ability to work in a virtual team environment In exchange we provide you with: Development opportunities: Roche is rich in learning resources. We provide constant development opportunities, free language courses & trainings, the possibility of international assignments, internal position changes and the chance to shape your own career. A global community , where we learn from each other. At Roche, we cooperate, debate, make decisions, celebrate successes and have fun as a team. Our leadership is very focused on people, creating a strong culture, so you always have the chance to share your opinion. Explore what the Global Digital Hub is about. Discover the Roche Services & Solutions Center and how we work together as a truly global team!
